subject.title: Feature: Add costCurrency config option to customize cost display currency

question: Should OpenClaw introduce a model-cost currency contract, and if so should currency live per model, per provider, or as a global display preference?
rationale: The request is useful, but current source and docs define model costs as USD per million tokens and root policy sets a high bar for new config surface, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design the currency contract first
options.body: Keep this open for maintainer direction, then implement one documented currency field with USD default and coverage across config, registry, and display surfaces.

options.title: Keep model estimates USD-only
options.body: Leave model-cost estimates as USD and direct non-USD account balances through the existing provider usage/billing snapshot path.

options.title: Make it display-only
options.body: Treat currency as a UI preference without changing model pricing semantics, accepting that the numeric cost values remain user-managed.

recommendation.title: Design the currency contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this open for maintainer direction, then implement one documented currency field with USD default and coverage across config, registry, and display surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-source history signal for the cost formatter, provider schema, and model-cost contract points to vincentkoc.
